def: An agent that keeps acquiring and reusing abilities across an open-ended sequence of tasks instead of starting each task from scratch.
A Minecraft agent that uses a language model to set its own tasks, write code for them, verify the code, and store working programs in a skill library.
A store of verified programs, each indexed by a description, that an agent retrieves and calls when solving new tasks.
A mechanism, often a language model, that proposes the agent's next task based on what it has done and failed so far.
Repeatedly asking a model to rewrite its code using feedback from the environment, interpreter errors and a critic until the task succeeds or attempts run out.
Having a separate model call (a critic) judge whether a task was completed and suggest fixes.
A model call that reviews an attempt's outcome and decides whether the task succeeded.
The loss of earlier abilities when a model's weights are updated to learn something new.
A skill written by calling other skills, so a harder task costs only the new part.
A requirement a stored skill silently relies on, such as an item already being in the inventory, which makes it fail in a different state.
Solving tasks in a new environment without further training, here by reusing a skill library built elsewhere.
